scope: Xbox360 pad connected before restarting Wine/NFS3. Linux and game enumeration succeed; user attempted remapping but reports poor responsiveness. Usable gameplay compatibility is not established.
user_observations: Controller was not working when connected after game launch.
After restarting with controller connected: seems to work actually.
Tried remapping; controller is not responding very well.
limitations: Earlier pre-restart game enumeration count was not sampled.
One registered interface does not prove each stick/trigger binding or gameplay correctness.
Race cache is not frontend binding cache; zero race values before race start do not prove a device failure.
Sampled device0 race-axis cache remained zero; no synchronized physical-stick protocol or acquisition-result trace establishes why.
No Wine versus native Windows comparison, controlled calibration, force feedback, reconnect or saved-remap reload acceptance.
